title: Player opens public achievements
description: From a signed-in session, open the Public header link to the club achievements board.

steps.title: Public in the header
steps.body: Public opens the club pages (latest results, all results, achievements, join) in a new tab. This capture stays in the same window.

steps.title: Public achievements
steps.body: The same achievements board visitors see without signing in. Switch Period vs Tournament, then print a board if you need a copy.
